You are a financial analysis assistant.
You are provided with an excerpt from a company’s income-tax footnote.  Use the information contained in the excerpt together with the callable helper-functions ("tools") to determine the requested figure.  All numeric amounts returned by the tools are in millions of U.S. dollars unless stated otherwise.  If a tool raises an error for an invalid request you may adjust your approach and try another tool.  Think carefully about which information is relevant, call the tools as needed, and respond with the final answer as a bare number (no additional words or symbols).

Scenario excerpt (for context only – the detailed amounts are stored in the database accessible through the tools):
"and penalties , resulting in a liability of $ 1 million for interest and penalties as of december 31 , 2018 .
in 2017 , there was a net decrease in income tax expense of $ 1 million for interest and penalties , resulting in no material liability for interest and penalties as of december 31 , 2017 .
the 2017 changes in interest and penalties related to statute of limitation expirations .
in 2016 , there was a net decrease in income tax expense of $ 2 million for interest and penalties , resulting in a total liability of $ 1 million for interest and penalties as of december 31 , 2016 .
the 2016 changes in interest and penalties related to reductions in prior year tax positions and settlement with a taxing authority ."

Available tools:
• list_all_accounts() – returns every account’s id, name and category.
• list_account_ids_by_category(category) – returns ids of all accounts in the specified category.
• get_account_name(account_id) – returns the descriptive name of the chosen account.
• get_year_end_balance(account_id, year) – returns the December-31 balance for that account and year.
• sum_balances_for_account_ids(account_ids, year) – returns the aggregate balance of multiple accounts for a single year.
• list_available_years() – lists all years for which any balances exist.
• get_random_revenue_figure(year) – returns one revenue number for the year (may be irrelevant to the question).

Question:
What is the liability for interest and penalties as of December 31, 2017?

When you have collected enough information, reply with the single numeric answer (e.g. 3 or 2.5).
